# AWS Serverless Three-Tier Web Application — Production Architecture Document

**Version:** 1.0 | **Region:** us-east-1 | **Classification:** Production-Ready

---

## 1. Executive Summary

This document outlines the production-grade architecture for a secure, globally scalable, fully serverless three-tier web application on AWS. It removes all infrastructure management by using only fully managed, pay-as-you-go services while ensuring enterprise-level security, observability, and compliance.

The solution delivers static content globally through Amazon CloudFront backed by Amazon S3, executes business logic using AWS Lambda via Amazon API Gateway (HTTP API), and stores application data in Amazon DynamoDB. Security is enforced using AWS WAF, Amazon Cognito authentication, and layered IAM controls.

**Key Outcomes:**
- **No infrastructure management** — fully managed and auto-scaling services
- **Usage-based pricing** — estimated $46–$78/month at moderate scale (1M page views, 500K API calls)
- **Global delivery** — CloudFront edge network with sub-50ms latency for static assets
- **Layered security** — WAF, Cognito JWT authentication, least-privilege IAM, KMS encryption, TLS 1.2+
- **Comprehensive observability** — CloudWatch, X-Ray tracing, CloudTrail logging

---

## 2. Architecture Overview

### 2.1 Logical Architecture Diagram

(unchanged diagram content)

### 2.2 Traffic Flow Summary

| Step | Path | Protocol | Security Control |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | User → Route 53 | DNS | DNSSEC optional |
| 2 | Route 53 → CloudFront | HTTPS | TLS 1.2+, WAF |
| 3 | CloudFront → S3 | HTTPS | OAC, bucket policy |
| 4 | CloudFront → API Gateway | HTTPS | WAF, auth header forwarding |
| 5 | API Gateway → Lambda | Internal | JWT validation, IAM |
| 6 | Lambda → DynamoDB | TLS | IAM, KMS |
| 7 | Services → Observability | Internal | IAM |

---

## 3. Component Details

### 3.1 Presentation Tier

#### 3.1.1 Amazon CloudFront

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Distribution Type | Web |
| Price Class | PriceClass_All |
| Minimum TLS | TLSv1.2_2021 |
| Viewer Policy | Redirect HTTP → HTTPS |
| Origin Protocol | HTTPS only |
| WAF | Enabled |
| HTTP/2 & HTTP/3 | Enabled |
| Logging | Enabled |
| Origin Shield | Enabled |
| Domain | yourdomain.com |
| Certificate | ACM (us-east-1) |

**Cache Behavior:**

- `/api/*` → API Gateway (no caching)
- `/static/*` → S3 (long TTL)
- Default → S3 (no caching, SPA routing)

**Error Handling:**
- 403 → `/index.html`
- 404 → `/index.html`

#### 3.1.2 Amazon S3 — Static Hosting

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Public Access | Disabled |
| Versioning | Enabled |
| Encryption | SSE-KMS |
| Access | CloudFront OAC only |

#### 3.1.3 Amazon Cognito — Authentication

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| MFA | TOTP + SMS |
| Password Policy | Strong (12+ chars, mixed types) |
| OAuth | Authorization Code + PKCE |
| Tokens | Access/ID: 1 hr, Refresh: 30 days |
| Client | Public SPA |

---

### 3.2 Business Logic Tier

#### 3.2.1 API Gateway (HTTP API)

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Protocol | HTTPS |
| Auth | Cognito JWT |
| WAF | Enabled |
| Logging | CloudWatch |
| Tracing | X-Ray |

**Routes:**
- GET `/health`
- CRUD `/items`
- GET/PUT `/profile`

#### 3.2.2 AWS Lambda

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Runtime | Node.js 20 / Python 3.12 |
| Memory | 256 MB |
| Timeout | 29 sec |
| Architecture | arm64 |
| Tracing | Enabled |

Each function has a dedicated IAM role with least privilege.

---

### 3.3 Data Tier

#### 3.3.1 DynamoDB

**Items Table:**
- PK: userId
- SK: itemId
- GSIs for itemId and status queries

**Users Table:**
- PK: userId
- SK: profileType
- GSI on email

All tables use:
- On-demand billing
- SSE-KMS encryption
- PITR enabled

---

### 3.4 Supporting Infrastructure

#### S3 Buckets

- Static assets
- CloudTrail logs
- CloudFront logs
- WAF logs

All buckets:
- Block public access
- Enforce TLS

#### KMS Keys

- Separate CMKs for S3 and DynamoDB
- Scoped access via IAM roles

---

## Design Principles

- Fully serverless architecture
- Least privilege IAM
- No direct public access to storage
- No DynamoDB scans in production
- End-to-end encryption
- Observability by default

---

## Conclusion

This architecture provides a scalable, secure, and cost-efficient serverless solution on AWS, suitable for production workloads requiring high availability, global reach, and strong security controls.
